output.title: California’s Potential Quartz Ban Pushes Contractors and Retailers to Alternatives
output.summary: Manufacturers and their customers are using materials made without the clouds of dust that have sickened workers in quartz-cutting shops.

output.title: Brazilian Markets Convulse After Unexpected Election Result
output.summary: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva’s re-election victory prompted a sharp reversal in financial markets that had expected his opponent to win.
